fullHistory.content:
Hey! I'm Roba Copilot — your co-pilot for the Unitree G1. Here's what we can do together:

🤖 Poses
"Make the robot wave its right arm."
"Sit the robot down and then stand up."
"Turn the torso left while raising both arms."

✋ Hands
"Open the left hand wide."
"Close the right hand into a fist."
"Spread the fingers of both hands for a greeting."
